title: Confirm one-frame control on fresh D8 games
doing: Freeze checkpoint420 and repeat all four sampled/argmax by repeat1/repeat4 settings on 256 new shared D8 seeds, with three controller repetitions per sampled condition:2,048 complete normal-start games. Keep architecture, model weights, runtime, reward, difficulty and 18,000-frame cap fixed. Primary replication contrast is sampled repeat1-minus-repeat4 Q1; success requires positive difference and a positive lower95% seed-cluster bootstrap bound.
expected: The large one-frame sampled lower-tail gain should persist on D8. Both selectors should benefit from one-frame control, while the relative Q1 ranking of the two one-frame selectors remains uncertain. A failed replication would weaken the timing hypothesis and hold the training comparison for reconciliation.
why: Fresh game seeds distinguish repeatable frozen-policy control-frequency effects from selection or chance on D7. Conditional on one checkpoint; controller repetitions are not training replicas. This does not distinguish quicker reactions from shorter harmful action holds.
next_step: Finish isolated successor source, actual startup qualification and independent reviews; register exact launch gates and execute once on AC. Prepare matched training protocol while inference runs, without launching training before terminal acceptance.

evidence.label: Prespecified D8 replication protocol and primary decision
